newsitem.title: USA: IP Forest Resources appoints new president.
newsitem.headline: IP Forest Resources appoints new president.

text.p: IP Forest Resources, a affiliate of International Paper, Tuesday, named George O'Brien as its president. O'Brien succeeds Edward J. Kobacker, who retired on April 1, 1997.
International Paper officials were not available to clarify its exact relationship with IP Forest Resources.

In a statement, the company said O'Brien will oversee the operations of IP Forest Resources, the managing general partner of IP Timberlands Ltd, a publically traded limited partnership that holds and manages International Paper's forestry and land holdings.
